plan.archetype: Early AoE into poison and dexterity scaling
plan.bossPrep: Bring AoE and focused damage to eliminate followers, sustained poison for the priest, improved block, and useful potions. Establish poison before relying on Accelerant.
plan.summary: The starter deck cannot beat this boss. Buy immediate damage first, then build poison and reliable defense. Remove Strikes as damage improves; attempt elites only after acquiring damage and potions.

plan.archetype: Shiv and AoE damage with dexterity-supported defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Echoing Slash when safe. Eliminate followers with focused attacks and AoE; bring sustained damage, stronger block, and useful potions.
plan.summary: Heal now and retain the minimum-elite route. Strengthen existing shivs with Accuracy, add dexterity and efficient defense, remove Strikes, and upgrade Echoing Slash when health permits.

plan.archetype: AoE follower kills with shiv scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy; upgrade Footwork or Echoing Slash, clear followers quickly, and reserve Weak and Dark Shackles for dangerous multihits.
plan.summary: Take full healing now and avoid another elite. Upgrade at the final campfire if healthy. Strengthen shiv damage and efficient defense without diluting the deck with speculative cards.

plan.archetype: Shiv damage and poison scaling behind dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with sustained damage scaling and defensive potions. Deploy Footwork early; save Dark Shackles or Piercing Wail for multihits.
plan.summary: Use Cocoa’s opening energy to establish powers and draw. Shop for sustained damage, efficient defense, and potions. Remove Poor Sleep then Strikes; avoid elites and upgrade core scaling when healthy.

plan.archetype: Shiv scaling with dexterity defense and draw
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with defensive potions. Establish Footwork and shiv powers early; reserve Dark Shackles for multihits. Upgrade Accuracy when health permits.
plan.summary: Keep the elite-free shop route. More shiv generation is the main damage priority; add efficient defense and draw. Preserve Defends for Footwork, remove Strikes, and heal before the boss if depleted.
